log.msg: Coordinator follow-up: day strip entries wrapped 2-3 rows at 900, pushing cards below the fold. Fixed with ai.css .ai-day-line (white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis) + dashboard.js day_strip() now sets title= the full text per line. Strip height before (wrapped): ~1550-1700px estimated from screenshot for 12 multi-row entries; after (one line each, measured): 685.65px for the same 12 entries + more line, all confirmed single-row (<30px each). Count already capped at STRIP_CAP=12+1; combined with nowrap this bounds the strip to a fixed ~13 lines at any width. Re-shot after-day-900.png -- task cards now visible below the strip.

Coordinator follow-up: fresh headless load of layout-primitives/ (own page.js, undeclared) rendered the GENERIC viewer -- confirmed a real race, async route() proven unfixable (route()s return value goes straight to add() with a plain if, no await; core/new/1/site/deep/errors/page.js documents Promise-from-route() as a known failure mode). Fix: has_page_js() now falls back to ONE synchronous XHR (blocking, same-origin, tiny file) the first time its asked before the async warm() cache has landed, so route() always has a correct answer, cold or warm -- moved warm() calls to ai/page.js/ai/2026-08-17/page.js module-eval time too (belt and suspenders, avoids the sync block whenever it wins). Proof: FRESH browser+context+page straight to /framework/ai/2026-08-17/layout-primitives/ (zero prior navigation) now renders its own page.js -- h1 Five layout words present, .ai-task .tabs absent. Regression-checked cold: report/ + vision-browse/ (own page.js) false-generic, ai-board-review/ + mastermind-run/ (no page.js) true-generic, all 4 correct, zero console errors. Files: ext/AITask/dashboard.js (fetch_sync + has_page_js), ai/page.js + ai/2026-08-17/page.js (warm() at module eval).

Coordinator follow-up (mastermind-shots): root cause of BOTH complaints was one bug. tab_bar() built every panels content (fn()) BEFORE setting .hidden on the panel div -- ext/Ask/chat.js bubble() calls $body.el.scrollIntoView() unconditionally for every history line, so on load the still-visible Session panel scrolled the page down to its last chat bubble; hidden was only applied a tick later, too late. The active tab class WAS toggling correctly (verified) but Mike could not see it because the scroll had carried the tab bar off-screen. Fix (AITask.js tab_bar() only, ext/AITask/** fence honored, no ext/Ask edit, no new CSS): $panel.el.hidden = true is now set BEFORE $panel.append(fn) runs, so scrollIntoView on a display:none subtree is a no-op. Proof on the live mastermind-shots page: scrollY===0 after fresh load+2s, scrollY===0 after appending a real live line to its task.jsonl (socket redraw), scrollY===0 after clicking Session, and Session correctly carries class="tab active" while Requirements/Report do not. Screenshot proof-mastermind-shots-session-active.png.

Coordinator follow-up: Session panel (chat+feed) now builds lazily on first click via tab_bar()s fill()/built Set, not at render -- panels array holds empty hidden divs until select() calls fill(name), same hidden-before-fill ordering as the scroll fix so scrollIntoView stays a no-op. Measured headless on mastermind-shots/: fresh load total response bytes 12.7MB -> 6.68MB (0 bytes from /ai-logs/ before any click, confirmed via response listener); clicking Session pulls the transcript on demand (+3.04MB from /ai-logs/, total 9.71MB) and .ai-feed renders (feedRendered:true). ext/AITask/AITask.js only, no other files touched.
